title: Weighted experiment value identity
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game, let $T$ be a finite randomised tester, and let $F$ assign a sign-valued Boolean function to each vertex of $G$. The value of the weighted constraint experiment associated with $G$ and $T$, under the assignment that gives each pair consisting of a vertex and a Boolean-cube input the value of $F$ at that vertex and input, equals the experiment value of $F$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued Boolean function assigned to each vertex
